title: canary-rollout-scratchpad-priya-kapoor
content:
Quick scratchpad for canary rollout of serving-runtime v2.3.0 + model pin updates

Context:
- Target: roll out serving-runtime v2.3.0 (perf kernels + KV cache fixes) + model variant pinning for gorilla-v2-quantized -> gorilla-v2-quantized-2026-01-15 (sha256:abc123...)
- Reason: reduce tail latency under batching and fix OOM seen on recent throughput tests
- Owner: Priya K (release lead)
- Small cohort customers already on Dedicated flagged for opt-in testing

High-level plan (tentative):
- Canary stages: 0% -> 1% -> 5% -> 20% -> 50% -> 100%
- Stage durations: 30m @ 1%, 60m @ 5%, 2h @ 20%, 4h @ 50% (can shorten if healthy)
- Rollout window: M-F 9:00-18:00 PT preferred; avoid Fri PM
- Pre-roll checklist below (do NOT merge until green)

Pre-roll checklist (must check off):
- [ ] GH PR #1248 merged & CI green
- [ ] Integration tests pass on canary infra (test-suite: smoke + perf-tiny)
- [ ] Canary cluster snapshot + backup created (s3://redwood-canary-snapshots/2026-02-20)
- [ ] Runbook up-to-date: confluence:runbooks/canary-rollout (link above)
- [ ] Pager/rotations alerted (oncall: @sre-oncall this week)
- [ ] Slack channel created/posted: #release-canary (pin runbook + PR link)
- [ ] Metrics dashboard: canary-rollout/v2.3.0 (token-level, p95/p99 latency, error rate, GPU mem, OOMs)
- [ ] Smoke prompt set loaded for quality checks (prompts/canary-smoke-2026-02-20.json)

Key metrics & thresholds (monitor continuously):
- Error rate (5xx + generation failures): alert if > 0.5% sustained for 5m
- p95 latency: must not increase > 15% relative to baseline for same batch sizes
- p99 latency: monitor but tolerate up to 30% increase for short spikes; investigate if sustained > 30m
- Cost per 1k tokens: report but not a release blocker unless > 40% increase
- GPU memory OOMs: any OOMs -> immediate rollback and incident page
- Model quality regressions (SMOKE set): fail if regression > 3% aggregated score or any deterministic hallucination in critical prompts

Rollout actions (ops):
- Update routing policy: create new variant route `serving-runtime:v2.3.0-canary` pinned to target model variants
- Deploy service to canary pool (k8s canary namespace) and verify pod readiness
- Start traffic at 1% for 30m, manual promote if no alerts
- Promotion command snippets:
  - kubectl apply -f k8s/canary/serving-runtime-v2.3.0.yaml
  - redwoodctl rollout set-traffic --service serving-runtime --percent 1 --variant v2.3.0-canary --env canary
  - redwoodctl monitor start --dashboard canary-rollout/v2.3.0 --slack #release-canary

Rollback criteria (immediate):
- Any OOM or GPU failure on canary nodes
- Error rate > 1.5% or sustained > 0.5% with customer impact
- p95 latency increase > 30% sustained for 15m
- Model quality smoke failure per runbook check

Rollback steps:
- redwoodctl rollout set-traffic --service serving-runtime --percent 0 --variant v2.3.0-canary --env canary
- kubectl scale deployment/serving-runtime-v2.3.0-canary --replicas=0 -n canary
- Re-pin routes back to baseline: redwoodctl route set --service serving-runtime --variant v2.2.7 --all
- Open incident in RI-4321 and inform #sre #release-canary

Version pinning notes:
- Model: gorilla-v2-quantized pinned to gorilla-v2-quantized-2026-01-15 (sha256:abc123...)
- Reason: validated quantization profiles, lower GPU mem in perf tests
- Migration: update model catalog entry and onboarding script (models/catalog.yaml) before canary
- Validate tokenizer compatibility - run tokenizer-check on sample corpus (script: scripts/check-tokenizer.sh)

Quality verification (manual / automated):
- Automated: run smoke suite every 10m against canary endpoints (script: test/ci/canary-smoke-runner)
- Manual: on-call to run 5 manual prompts from smoke set after each promotion step and paste results to #release-canary
- If model drift seen, capture logs + request ids and tag PR for rollback

Notes / open questions / TODOs:
- Q: Do we need to bump quantization profile config in runtime? (ask @applied-ml)
- Q: Are customer canaries included in 1% traffic bucket? confirm with product-ops (LR-512)
- TODO: update Canary cost forecast in sheet (sheets:canary-cost-forecast-feb)
- TODO: get final signoff from security on new runtime flags (feature-flags: enable_kernel_opt_v2)

Useful refs:
- GH PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving-runtime/pull/1248
- Jira: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RI-4321
- Runbook: confluence:runbooks/canary-rollout
- Slack: #release-canary

Scratch notes (brain dump):
- If we see small p95 increase but big p99, might be due to rare long-context requests — check request size histogram -> consider dynamic batching tweak
- Consider enabling prefix caching for top-robots route during canary to reduce variance
- Keep canary GPU pool isolated (no autoscale to public cluster) to avoid cross-tenant impact

End of scratchpad. Will tidy up into formal checklist before scheduling rollout.
